claims.text: Gazette Extraordinary No. 9 of Monday 19 March 2012 carries a proclamation in the name of His Majesty Tupou VI, by Prime Minister Lord Tu'ivakano, stating that by the decease of His Late Majesty King George Tupou V the Crown of the Kingdom of Tonga devolves upon Crown Prince Tupouto'a Lavaka. The Cabinet Ministers, Speaker Lasike and Chief Justice Michael Dishington Scott proclaim that Crown Prince Tupouto'a Lavaka has now become King of the Kingdom of Tonga, as King Tupou VI. It is given at Nuku'alofa on 19 March 2012, with a Tongan FANONGONONGO to the same effect.
claims.uncertainty: The proclamation is its own event, dated 19 March 2012, and prints no accession time. The accession date (18 March 2012) rests on its statement that the Crown devolves by the decease, with the death date and time from Gazette Extraordinary No. 8; the proclamation date is not used as the start.
